# Gcore Video Streaming

> Gcore Video Streaming covers live and uploaded video delivery, transcoding, HLS and MPEG-DASH playback, player settings, and secure access.

- [Gcore Video Streaming](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming.md): Gcore Video Streaming covers live and uploaded video delivery, transcoding, HLS and MPEG-DASH playback, player settings, and secure access.

## Getting started
- [Start working with Gcore Streaming](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/getting-started/start-work.md): Start with Gcore Streaming for live streaming, video hosting, billing, REST methods, and troubleshooting.
- [Plan accounts for development and production](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/getting-started/dev_environment.md): Compare Gcore Streaming account models for development and production workflows and isolation.
- [Demo](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/getting-started/demo.md): Gcore built-in player demos for VOD and live streams with HLS and MPEG-DASH examples.

## AI video services
- [AI video services](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/video-hosting/ai-video-service.md): Gcore AI video services generate subtitles and moderate content for nudity and sports activities.

## Content moderation
- [Not safe for work (NSFW) detection](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/ai-video-service/content-moderation/nsfw-detection.md): Scan MP4 videos for NSFW content and get confidence scores for flagged frames.
- [Hard nudity detection](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/ai-video-service/content-moderation/ai-nudity-detection.md): Hard nudity detection scans MP4 videos for explicit genital nudity and reports confidence scores for each detection.
- [Soft nudity detection](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/ai-video-service/content-moderation/soft-nudity-detection.md): Soft nudity detection analyzes MP4 videos for exposed body parts and faces, returning confidence scores for each detected element.
- [Sport detection](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/ai-video-service/content-moderation/sport-detection.md): Identify sporting activities in videos with Gcore sport detection, including task creation, result polling, and cancellation.

## Generate and translate captions
- [Generate and translate captions](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/video-hosting/ai-for-video/generate-ai-subtitles-and-add-them-to-video.md): Gcore ASR generates and translates AI captions for video in over 100 languages, handling multiple speakers and code-switching.
- [Generate and translate AI captions](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/ai-video-service/generate-ai-subtitles-and-add-them-to-video/generate-captions-in-customer-portal.md): Generate and translate AI captions for Gcore-hosted or external MP4 videos with transcription tasks and downloadable VTT files.

## Billing
- [Overview of Streaming tariffs](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/billing/overview-of-tariffs.md): Gcore Streaming tariffs explained, including the 14-day PAYG trial, active PAYG limits, pricing, and custom enterprise plans.
- [Streaming usage and billing reports](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/billing/usage-and-billing-reports.md): Gcore Streaming usage and billing reports explain how delivery, transcoding, storage, and concurrency usage is calculated for billing.

## Codecs and protocols
- [Accepted input parameters for live streams and videos](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/live-streams-and-videos-protocols-and-codecs/input-parameters-and-codecs.md): Accepted input parameters for Gcore Streaming live streams and VOD files include video codecs, ingest protocols, and recommended settings.
- [Output parameters after transcoding: codecs, bitrate, frame rate](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/live-streams-and-videos-protocols-and-codecs/output-parameters-and-codecs.md): Gcore Streaming transcoding output uses H.264 video and AAC audio by default, with ABR ladders, HLS and MPEG-DASH, plus HEVC and AV1.
- [RTMP](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/live-streaming/protocols/rtmp.md): Configure RTMP and RTMPS live stream ingest with Gcore Streaming, including encoder settings, push and pull modes, and troubleshooting.
- [SRT](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/live-streaming/protocols/srt.md): Set up SRT live stream ingest with push and pull modes, latency, passphrase protection, encoder commands, limits, and troubleshooting.
- [WebRTC WHIP to HLS/DASH](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/live-streaming/protocols/webrtc.md): Stream WebRTC WHIP from a browser and get automatic transcoding to low-latency HLS or DASH for CDN delivery.
- [RTMP vs SRT: protocol comparison](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/live-streaming/protocols/rtmp-srt.md): Compare RTMP and SRT streaming protocols, including how each handles packet loss, jitter, latency, and limited bandwidth.

## Player
- [Built-in web player](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/player/customize-appearance-of-the-built-in-player.md): Customize the Gcore built-in web player with colors, logo, playback speed, autoplay, and embed options for live and VOD.
- [JS Video Player & SDK](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/player/player-api-tutorial.md): Gcore JS Video Player SDK supports LIVE and VOD streaming with HLS, MPEG-DASH, and MP4, plus custom skins and plugins.

## Extra features
- [Video streaming API tutorial](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/api/streaming-platform-api-tutorial.md): Video streaming integration tutorial covering setup, testing, live streams, stopping, webhooks, and special cases.
- [Webhooks on system state changes](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/extra-features/get-webhooks-from-the-streaming-platform.md): Webhooks on system state changes notify apps about live stream, VOD, and restream events without polling.

## Interaction with CDN
- [Get started with CDN for video streaming](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/interaction-with-cdn/get-started-streaming-cdn.md): Get started with CDN for video streaming, including billing, default subdomain, and delivery approaches.
- [Custom CDN resources for Video Streaming](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/interaction-with-cdn/custom-cdn-resource.md): Set up a custom CDN resource for Video Streaming to add custom domains, geo-blocking, secure tokens, and per-GB billing.
- [Protect content with video secure tokens](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/interaction-with-cdn/video-secure-token.md): Restrict video access with video secure tokens that embed a signed token and expiration in each URL for CDN validation.
- [Generate secure tokens for HLS/DASH](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/interaction-with-cdn/generate-hls-dash-token.md): Generate HLS and DASH secure tokens with MD5 hashing, expiration, and optional IP binding.
- [Generate advanced secure tokens for MP4](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/interaction-with-cdn/generate-mp4-token.md): Generate advanced secure tokens for MP4 files with signing parameters, expiration, speed limits, and IP binding examples.
- [Auto-refresh video secure tokens](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/interaction-with-cdn/token-auto-refresh.md): Auto-refresh video secure tokens keep HLS and DASH URLs short-lived, rotating tokens before expiry to stop copied links from working.
- [Create a video token API with FastEdge](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/interaction-with-cdn/token-api-fastedge.md): Create a video token with FastEdge to sign CDN URLs at the edge using WebAssembly and environment variables.
- [Add token auto-refresh to a video player](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/interaction-with-cdn/player-token-refresh.md): Add token auto-refresh to a video player with TokenRefreshPlugin for hls.js and dash.js streams.

## Live streaming
- [Live Streaming overview](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/live-streaming/getting-started-with-live-streaming.md): Gcore Live Streaming ingests video over RTMP, SRT, or WebRTC WHIP and delivers low-latency HLS and MPEG-DASH globally via CDN.

## Manage live streams
- [Create and manage a live stream](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/live-streaming/create-a-live-stream.md): Create, configure, and manage live streams with push or pull ingest, DVR recording, and embed playback in Gcore Live Streaming.
- [Delete or disable a live stream](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/live-streaming/delete-live-stream.md): Disable a Gcore live stream to pause ingest and playback, or delete it permanently when settings and statistics are no longer needed.
- [Live stream screenshots](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/live-streaming/live-stream-screenshots.md): Live stream screenshots show the latest frame of an active broadcast and update every 10 seconds for player placeholders.
- [Stream metrics](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/statistics/view-your-live-stream-metrics.md): Track live stream metrics including concurrent viewers, bitrate, FPS, and key frame interval with time-series charts and viewer count data.

## Broadcasting software
- [FFmpeg](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/live-streaming/broadcasting-software/ffmpeg.md): Push a live stream to Gcore Video Streaming with FFmpeg over RTMP using recommended encoding settings and optional resolution downscaling.
- [GStreamer](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/live-streaming/broadcasting-software/gstreamer.md): Push a live stream to Gcore Video Streaming with GStreamer using RTMP or SRT and H.264 AAC encoding.
- [Larix](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/live-streaming/broadcasting-software/larix.md): Set up Larix Broadcaster for Gcore Video Streaming and configure RTMP stream, camera, video, and audio encoder parameters.
- [Open Broadcaster Software](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/live-streaming/broadcasting-software/obs.md): Set up Open Broadcaster Software for Gcore Video Streaming with RTMP server details, encoding, audio, video, and streaming settings.
- [Instant clips](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/live-streaming/clips.md): Create instant clips from a live stream DVR buffer, list them, and save highlights as permanent VODs before they expire.
- [Pause and rewind live streams](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/live-streaming/pause-and-rewind-the-live-streams.md): DVR lets viewers pause and rewind live streams, with a default 1 hour window extendable to 4 hours and 24 hours for Enterprise accounts.
- [Low-latency streaming](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/live-streaming/how-low-latency-streaming-works.md): Gcore low-latency streaming reduces live video delay to 2 to 5 seconds with LL-HLS and LL-DASH over CMAF.
- [Configure low-latency playback](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/live-streaming/configure-low-latency-playback.md): Tune encoders and players for stable low-latency streaming, with fixes for stalls, slow segments, and device support.
- [Combine multiple live streams](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/live-streaming/combine-multiple-live-streams.md): Combine multiple live streams into one multicamera player so viewers can switch camera angles and manage broadcast status.
- [Insert an overlay (HTML widgets) in your live stream](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/live-streaming/insert-html-overlays-in-live-streams.md): Add HTML overlays and widgets to live streams with Gcore, covering embedding methods, examples, and overlay management.
- [PTS and DTS in RTMP/SRT streams](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/live-streaming/pts-dts.md): PTS and DTS timestamp issues in RTMP and SRT streams, including causes, transcoder behavior, diagnosis, and encoder fixes.
- [Primary, Backup, and Global Ingest Points for PUSH and PULL](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/live-streaming/primary-backup.md): Set up primary, backup, and global ingest points for PUSH and PULL live streams, with RTMP, SRT, and WebRTC WHIP protocols and failover.
- [Record live streams](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/live-streaming/record-your-live-streams-and-save-them-as-videos.md): Record live streams and save them as videos in Video Hosting, with manual start, stop, and recording settings.
- [Create and configure a restream](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/live-streaming/create-and-configure-a-restream-to-social-media.md): Create and configure a restream to forward live streams to YouTube, Facebook, Twitch, or RTMP and SRT targets.
- [WebRTC to HLS/DASH](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/live-streaming/webrtc-to-hls-dash.md): Publish a browser camera and microphone stream to Gcore over WebRTC and convert it to HLS and MPEG-DASH for playback.

## Q&A and Use cases
- [Streaming FAQs](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/faq/streaming-faq.md): Answers to common questions about Gcore Video Streaming, including billing, AI video features, and live streaming.
- [Configure hot-swapping with AWS Elemental Live and Nimble Streamer](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/faq/case-study-hot-swapping-elemental.md): Troubleshoot failed hot-swaps between AWS Elemental Live and Nimble Streamer by checking SRT late packets and PTS stalls.
- [Video streaming HTTP status codes](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/faq/http-status-codes.md): Gcore Video Streaming HTTP status codes for manifests and chunks, including the X-Err-Code header for CMAF live streams.
- [Live Streaming issues](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/faq/live-streaming-issues.md): Troubleshoot common Gcore Live Streaming issues such as buffering, empty manifests, SRT artifacts, RTMP freezes, and restream failures.
- [VOD issues](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/faq/vod-issues.md): Troubleshoot common VOD upload, transcoding, and playback errors including HTTP 503, stuck Pending status, and slow segment latency.

## WebRTC issues
- [Fix the camera or microphone if they do not work](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/faq/real-time-video-issues/fix-the-camera-or-microphone-if-they-do-not-work.md): Fix crossed-out camera or microphone icons in Gcore Real-Time Video by checking browser and system permissions, extensions, and network.
- [Audio quality is reduced when using Bluetooth headsets in video call apps](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/faq/real-time-video-issues/audio-quality-is-reduced-when-using-bluetooth-headsets-in-video-call-apps.md): Bluetooth headset audio quality drops in video calls when the microphone switches from A2DP to HSP or HFP.

## Statistics
- [Video player metrics](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/statistics/statistics-of-built-in-player.md): Video player metrics cover engagement, average view duration, viewer counts, audience browsers, geography, hosts, and operating systems.
- [Video views and delivered minutes](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/statistics/statistics-of-views.md): Track video views, unique viewers, and delivered minutes for one video in Gcore Video Hosting statistics.
- [View statistics of live streams and videos](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/statistics/view-statistics-of-live-streams-videos-and-billing.md): View statistics for live streams and videos in Gcore, covering viewers, browsers, geography, hosts, and popular videos.

## Video hosting
- [Getting started with video hosting](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/video-hosting/getting-started-with-video-hosting.md): Gcore Video Hosting stores, transcodes, and delivers video-on-demand content as adaptive HLS, MPEG-DASH, and MP4 renditions.

## Manage library
- [Upload a video and embed it into your app](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/video-hosting/upload-a-video-and-embed-it-to-your-app.md): Upload a video to Gcore Video Hosting and embed it with the player, an iframe snippet, or a direct playback link.
- [Organize uploaded videos](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/video-hosting/organize-uploaded-videos.md): Organize uploaded videos in Gcore Video Hosting with directories and tags for grouping, moving, renaming, filtering, and deleting.
- [Delete uploaded videos](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/video-hosting/delete-videos.md): Delete uploaded videos in Gcore video hosting to permanently remove transcoded versions, subtitles, screenshots, and related files.
- [Download files](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/video-hosting/original-files.md): Download transcoded MP4 files from Gcore Video Streaming by selecting video quality in video settings.
- [Protect videos with AES-128 encryption](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/video-hosting/protect-your-videos-with-the-aes-128-encryption.md): AES-128 encryption protects HLS video chunks by using a keyserver to control access to the decryption key.
- [HEVC, AV1, and VP9 multi-codec VOD](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/video-hosting/multi-codec.md): Create HEVC, AV1, and VP9 renditions from VOD sources to cut CDN traffic costs with codec-specific HLS and MPEG-DASH manifests.
- [HLS, MPEG-DASH, and MP4](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/video-hosting/hls-and-mp4.md): Compare HLS, MPEG-DASH, and MP4 delivery formats, playback links, manifest URLs, and quality ranges for Gcore video hosting.
- [Download and deliver MP4 files](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/video-hosting/download-mp4-files.md): Download and deliver MP4 files from Gcore Video Streaming, including per-quality downloads, speed limits, secure tokens, and byte ranges.
- [Create an illusion of a live broadcast with uploaded videos](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/video-hosting/create-an-illusion-of-a-live-broadcast-with-uploaded-videos.md): Schedule uploaded videos as a live imitation broadcast, with playlist order, start time, and active playback settings.
- [Videos with multiple audio tracks](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/video-hosting/multi-audio.md): Videos with multiple audio tracks let viewers switch languages during HLS and DASH playback.
- [Create and configure playlists for videos](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/video-hosting/create-and-configure-playlists-for-videos.md): Create and configure video playlists of up to 128 videos, set playback order, and copy the embed code for a website.
- [Video Lifecycle and Statuses](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/video-hosting/vod-status.md): Video lifecycle and statuses explained, from empty and pending through viewable and ready, with rendition progress and error handling.
- [Subtitles and closed captions for VOD](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/video-hosting/subtitles-and-closed-captions-for-vod.md): Add subtitles and closed captions to VOD videos with SRT or WebVTT files, including AI generated tracks and language selection.
- [Timeline hover previews: use with players and Roku devices](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/video-hosting/timeline-hover-previews-use-in-players-and-roku-devices.md): Timeline hover previews use storyboard tiles with players and Roku devices via WebVTT and HLS.
- [Upload video via API to VOD storage](https://docs.gcore.com/streaming/video-hosting/upload-video-via-api.md): Upload video to VOD storage by copying from external URL or using TUS resumable protocol, with batch migration and optional settings.
